standard.title: Homophones and context spelling
standard.description: read and write high-frequency words including homophones and know how to use context to identify correct spelling
standard.prior_knowledge: Students recognise and write most high-frequency words including some homophones (AC9E3LY12). They have not yet applied contextual and syntactical clues systematically to determine correct homophone spelling.
standard.progression_endpoint: Students can read and write high-frequency words including homophones, applying contextual and syntactical clues to select the correct spelling in context.

nodes.label: Identifying homophone pairs
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can identify homophone pairs and distinguish the meaning of each word in the pair.
nodes.minimum_width: Identify at least three homophone pairs and give the meaning of each word.
nodes.typical_width: Identify a range of common homophone pairs (our/hour, their/there/they're, to/too/two, hear/here, wear/ware/where) and explain the distinct meaning of each, noting part of speech where relevant.
wider: Collect homophones encountered in reading across a week and build a personal homophone reference list with meanings and example sentences
Investigate near-homophones and confusables (e.g. affect/effect, then/than) and develop memory strategies for distinguishing them
nodes.hinge_reason: Using context to select the correct homophone in N2 requires students to know both words in the pair — without knowing the alternatives, students cannot apply the meaning-check that N2 requires.

response_modes.reason: Knowing homophone pairs is a memory task that requires repeated encounter to become reliable — students need to recognise both words in a pair before context checking is possible.

success_criteria: Can name at least three homophone pairs
Can explain the different meaning of each word in at least two pairs

nodes.label: Using context to select correct spelling
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can use contextual and syntactical clues to identify and write the correct homophone in a sentence.
nodes.minimum_width: Select the correct homophone in at least three sentences using context clues and explain the clue used.
nodes.typical_width: Apply contextual and syntactical clues systematically to select the correct homophone across a range of sentences and texts, explaining why the context determines the spelling choice.
wider: Edit a piece of writing specifically for homophone errors, explaining the reasoning for each correction
Examine how homophone errors in published or digital texts change meaning and discuss the importance of proofreading

response_modes.reason: Correct homophone selection in context requires automatic triggering of the meaning-check habit. Students who know the pairs still make errors in fluent writing without consistent practice building the checking habit.

success_criteria: Can select the correct homophone in a sentence and name the context clue that determines the choice
Does not rely on sound alone — uses meaning or part of speech to determine the correct form
